_why: The absolutes family, declared here and nowhere else. s21-claims-guard reads THIS record; the list is never typed into the gate. A literal that nothing binds is this estate's most frequent defect, and a gate holding its own private copy of the thing it checks is the same defect wearing a lab coat.
_scope: Served /for/*/index.html. Matched case-insensitively as substrings of the visible page.

_whyEachIsBanned.gdpr: GDPR compliance belongs to the school as data controller. A tool cannot hold it on their behalf, so no phrasing that implies it may be served.
_whyEachIsBanned.zero-dpia: Not a thing a DPO accepts. Whether a DPIA is needed is the setting's assessment, not ours to pre-empt.
_whyEachIsBanned.absolutes: Certified / Guaranteed / fully compliant assert an authority that has not been granted.
_whyEachIsBanned.licensing: There is no licensing programme. Naming one invents a commercial arrangement.
_whyEachIsBanned.trauma-informed: A professional label, not a self-description. Same family as an approval claim.
